name: DEVASTATION : Physics Sandbox
summary:
**Shoot out the supports. Watch the tower fall.**

DEVASTATION VR is a destruction sandbox. Everything built breaks into chunks, buildings collapse when their supports go, towers topple whole and fire spreads.
